title: Frost Darts Skill Guide — Ice Darts, Cold Infusion and the Post-Freeze Explosion
summary: Frost Darts is a cold spell: it fires multiple ice darts that, after hitting already chilled / frozen targets, create an Ice Chunk and pin-explode. This guide explains why the base projectile can't self-chill / freeze, how Cold Infusion is gained and consumed, the pin-explode behaviour after Infusion, that projectile and explosion are different damage segments, and Mapping vs Boss setup skills.
description: Deep Frost Darts cold spell guide: base projectile vs chill / freeze prerequisite, Cold Infusion gain and consumption, Ice Chunk pin-explode, projectile and explosion two-segment damage, Fork / Ricochet / Cast Speed tradeoffs, Chronomancer synergy, Mapping vs Boss setup and community issues.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Overview: What Frost Darts Does
paragraphs: Frost Darts is a cold spell: you fire a stream of ice darts (darts) dealing cold damage to enemies in their path. The most misunderstood part is players thinking 'mindless spam freezes everything' — actually the base projectile alone is not enough to reliably chill / freeze; its real value comes from the 'Ice Chunk and explosion after hitting already chilled / frozen targets' payoff mechanic.

It is a typical 'Payoff Spell': first use other cold means (like Frost Bomb, Ice Nova) to chill / freeze enemies and accumulate Cold Infusion, then let Frost Darts 'cash out' — hitting frozen targets spawns an Ice Chunk and pin-explodes, dealing far more damage than the bare projectile.

In cold-spell leagues like Chronomancer, Frost Darts is often the boss single-target tool: clear relies on Ice Nova etc. to blanket area, while boss relies on Frost Darts cashing in fully-charged Cold Infusion burst. Understanding 'first lay chill / freeze and Infusion, then let Darts cash out' is the key to using it correctly.
bullets: Essence: cold spell projectile + Ice Chunk pin-explode on chilled / frozen targets (Payoff).
Base projectile can't reliably self-chill / freeze; value from the Payoff segment.
Typical Payoff Spell: first Frost Bomb / Ice Nova to lay chill and Infusion.
Typical carrier: Chronomancer cold-spell league (boss single-target tool).

sections.title: Core Mechanics: Chill / Freeze Prerequisite, Cold Infusion, Pin-Explode Two Segments
paragraphs: Why the base projectile can't self-chill / freeze: a single Frost Darts ice dart has limited chill / freeze accumulation; pure spam rarely freezes a normal target. You need to first apply chill / freeze with other cold skills (Frost Bomb, Ice Nova, Frost Wall etc.) before Frost Darts enters its 'high-value state'.

How Cold Infusion is gained and consumed: Cold Infusion is a kind of 'charge' generated by cold spells (e.g. accumulated when attacking with cold skills like Frost Bomb). Frost Darts, when holding Cold Infusion, consumes it for extra cold damage / enhanced effect — so 'accumulate Infusion first, then cast Darts' is the core of the damage loop, not the reverse.

Pin and explode after Infusion: when Darts hit an already chilled / frozen target (and usually with Infusion full), they spawn an Ice Chunk pinned to the target then explode. This is its highest-damage form and the source of boss single-target burst.

Projectile and explosion are different damage segments: Darts' own projectile is one damage segment; the Ice Chunk explosion generated on hit is a second damage segment. Evaluate strength by adding both, not just the projectile.
bullets: First Frost Bomb / Ice Nova to lay chill and Infusion, then cast Darts.
Cold Infusion generated by cold skills, consumed by Darts for enhancement.
Hit frozen target → Ice Chunk pin-explode, the highest-damage form.
Projectile segment one + pin-explode segment two; total is both added.

sections.title: Role and Differences Across Builds
paragraphs: Chronomancer (Temporal) cold spell: the most typical Frost Darts carrier. Chronomancer's Time Snap, Temporal Rift etc. provide cooldown reduction and time manipulation, pairing with the cold-spell system to use Frost Darts as the boss single-target cash-out tool — clear relies on Ice Nova to blanket, while boss relies on Frost Bomb exposure + chill / freeze + Cold Infusion maxed, then Frost Darts pin-explodes.

Clear vs single-target difference: while clearing, Fork / Ricochet let ice darts chain-cover, relying on chill blanket rather than pin-explode; on boss you first lay chill / freeze and Infusion, then let Darts hit frozen targets to spawn pin-explode, cashing in the second-segment damage. The two require different supports and prerequisite skills.

Interaction with other cold skills: Frost Bomb (exposure / chill), Frost Wall (block + chill), Ice Nova (blanket freeze), Freezing Mark (freeze reliability) together form the prerequisite. Frost Darts is the 'cash-out' at the end of this chain, not the opener.
bullets: Chronomancer: Darts is the boss single-target cash-out; clear relies on Ice Nova.
Clear: Fork / Ricochet chain-cover; Boss: lay chill / Infusion then pin-explode.
Prerequisite relies on Frost Bomb / Frost Wall / Ice Nova / Freezing Mark; Darts at chain end.

sections.title: Common Mistakes: Why Spamming Alone Underperforms
paragraphs: Naked Frost Darts spam: without first laying chill / freeze and Cold Infusion, the projectile's chill accumulation is limited, and neither damage nor pin-explode appears. Correct practice is Frost Bomb / Ice Nova first to lay chill and accumulate Infusion, then Darts.
Not consuming Cold Infusion: Infusion is Darts' enhancement source; without Infusion Darts is just a normal ice dart. Confirm your loop has the 'generate Infusion → immediately Darts cash-out' order.

Expecting the base projectile to freeze: the base ice dart is insufficient to reliably freeze normal targets; freeze should come from prerequisite cold skills (or Freezing Mark). Don't blame Darts for 'not freezing'.
Same link for clear and boss: clear wants Fork / Ricochet coverage, boss wants pin-explode and Infusion; mixing leaves both mediocre. Switch per scene or prepare two links.
Ignoring Chronomancer's cooldown / time mechanics: Time Snap, Temporal Rift etc. improve rhythm and survival; not using them wastes the ascendancy value.
bullets: Problem: low spam damage. Direct answer: first Frost Bomb / Ice Nova lay chill + Infusion, then Darts.
Problem: no pin-explode. Direct answer: ensure Cold Infusion consumed and hitting frozen target.
Problem: can't freeze. Direct answer: freeze comes from prerequisite cold skills, not Darts' naked projectile.
Problem: clear / boss both mediocre. Direct answer: clear uses Fork / Ricochet, boss uses pin-explode + Infusion.

items.question: Why does Frost Darts alone underperform?
answer: The base projectile's chill / freeze accumulation is limited; the pin-explode (Payoff) doesn't appear.
First Frost Bomb / Ice Nova to lay chill and Cold Infusion, then Darts to cash out.

items.question: How do I get and consume Cold Infusion?
answer: Accumulated when cold spells (like Frost Bomb) attack.
Frost Darts, when holding Infusion, consumes it for enhancement — the core of the damage loop.

items.question: What does Frost Darts handle in a build?
answer: It is the 'cash-out' tool at the end of the cold-spell chain, especially strong for boss single-target pin-explode.
Clear is usually blanketed by Ice Nova etc.; Darts doesn't handle the opener chill lay.

items.question: Can clear and boss use the same link?
answer: Not really recommended. Clear wants Fork / Ricochet coverage; boss wants pin-explode and Infusion.
Switch per scene or prepare two links for stability.
